findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the facility to be repackaging and selling ice in cups. Facility is not permitted to handle food. Ensure this practice is ceased or that the permit is upgraded to a medium risk. Inspector will return 12/04/2025 to re-inspect permit-level activities.
findings.citation_text: 2-103.11(Q) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (Q) Written procedures and plans, where specified by this Code and as developed by the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, are maintained and implemented as required.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the facility to have no dedicated hand sink. There is a sink that is used as a dump sink and for hands. Ensure that the facility either installs a new sink for hand washing, or uses this sink only for hand washing. Inspector will return 12/04/2025 to re-inspect the hand sink.
findings.citation_text: 2-301.15 Where to Wash. FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK or APPROVED automatic handwashing facility and may not clean their hands in a sink used for FOOD preparation or WAREWASHING, or in a service sink or a curbed cleaning facility used for the disposal of mop water and similar liquid waste.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment: Facility does not have a dedicated hand sink where ice is packaged. Follow-up on 12/04/2025
findings.citation_text: 5-204.11 Handwashing Sinks. A HANDWASHING SINK shall be located: (A) To allow convenient use by EMPLOYEES in FOOD preparation, FOOD dispensing, and WAREWASHING areas; and (B) In, or immediately adjacent to, toilet rooms.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source.
findings.comment: Facility is repackaging ice into cups to be sold. Cups are unlabeled, and come from a source not meant to be repackaged and sold. Ensure that this practice stops. Inspector will return 12/04/2025 to re-inspect ice packaging process.
findings.citation_text: 3-201.11(A) Compliance with Food Law. (A) FOOD shall be obtained from sources that comply with LAW.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: The facility has no 3 compartment sink to wash utensils which pack the ice. Facility should not be repacking ice. Ensure this practice stops. Inspector will return 12/04/2025 to re-inspect the warewashing area.
findings.citation_text: 4-301.12(A) Manual Warewashing, Sink Compartment Requirements. (A) Except as specified in (C) of this section, a sink with at least 3 compartments shall be provided for manually washing, rinsing, and SANITIZING EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS.

findings.title: Charge present, demonstrates knowledge, and performs duties
findings.comment:
Based on the violations observed during inspection, line item #1 is out of compliance.  The facility is currently operating as a low risk facility, but selling cups of ice packaged at the facility.  Facility is operating outside of their permit.

2-102.11: Based on the RISKS inherent to the FOOD operation, PIC shall demonstrate knowledge by:  (A) Having no Priority Foundation items; (B) Being a CFM; OR (C) Responding correctly questions as they relate to the specific FOOD operation. The areas of knowledge include C1 through C16.

findings.title: Hands clean and properly washed
findings.comment:
No hand washing sink is available at the facility.  Owner stated a sink is located in the facility, but confirmed it is not used a hand washing only sink.  Hands could not have been properly washed before packaging without the proper facilities.

2-301.15: FOOD EMPLOYEES shall clean their hands in a HANDWASHING SINK only.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
Facility is not adequately equipped with a hand washing sink where the ice is packaged.  Proper hand washing must occur before handling food.  Cease the practice of packaging and selling individual cups of ice.

5-204.11: A HANDWASHING SINK shall be located: (A) To allow convenient use by EMPLOYEES in FOOD preparation, FOOD dispensing, and WAREWASHING areas (B) In, or immediately adjacent to, toilet rooms.

findings.title: Food obtained from approved source
findings.comment:
Cups of ice were observed in a freezer for individual sale.  This Class III low risk establishment does not have the proper facilities to allow for repackaging of bags of ice into individual cups for sale.  Cups are not properly labeled with its contents, nor was the bag of ice used meant to be separated, repackaged, and sold.

3-201.11: (A)-(B) FOOD shall be obtained from APPROVED source and not from private home. P (C) PACKAGED Food shall be properly labeled.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
A 3 part sink is not located in the facility to properly wash, rinse, and sanitize any utensils used to package food.  A 3 part sink must be present in order to sell repackaged ice.

4-301.12: (A) Sink with 3-compartments shall be provided for EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS. (B) Sinks shall be capable of accommodating the immersion of the largest piece of EQUIPMENT or UTENSIL. A machine or alternative option can be used. Reference 4-301.12 Pf (C) Alternative manual WAREWASHING EQUIPMENT may be used for special cleaning C

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces designed, constructed, maintained, installed, located.
findings.comment: Observed broken seal on the Pepsi cooler. Repair the broken seal on the Pepsi cooler door.

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: .140) No thermometer in ice cream freezer.  Corrected.
